final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT c.state_county_province, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), state_shares AS (SELECT account_count, 1.0 * account_count / (SELECT SUM(account_count) FROM state_counts) AS share FROM state_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM state_shares) SELECT SUM(s.account_count) AS combined_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_excess FROM state_shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value
